summary: One-frame event put on a character that the client could not add to a party group (ecl::party::CanGroupCharacters failed), carrying the player id the request came from. Written by ecl::party::PartySystem::Update (bg3.exe+0x1948080) beside GroupsChanged/PartyChanged/Loaded events. Never seen alive. Registry total 2 (client row).

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x194A9E0 (AllocRaw 2) stores `*(undefined2*)p = 0`. PartySystem update bg3.exe+0x1948080 collects an entity->uint16 map (keys at local_238, values local_228) filled by bg3.exe+0x1948600 and bg3.exe+0x1949430, then for each key creates this component and writes `*(undefined2*)p = value`. The value stored in those maps is `(short)*(uint*)(character + 300)` (0 when the high half is set) - the same player id that ecl::ftb::BlockedFTBRequestOneFrameComponent keeps as int16 PlayerId.
